paper.title_en: The ratio of gradient-flow scales $\sqrt{t_0}/w_0$ in $2+1$ flavor lattice QCD
paper.abstract_en: We determine the ratio $\sqrt{t_0}/w_0$ of gradient-flow scales in isospin-symmetric $2+1$-flavor QCD at the physical point and in the continuum limit. Our analysis uses CLS gauge ensembles at five lattice spacings and combines Wilson and Zeuthen flow data to constrain the continuum extrapolation at the flavor-SU(3)-symmetric point. We obtain $\sqrt{t_0}/w_0=0.8264(26)$ in the Edinburgh consensus scheme, corresponding to a precision of about $0.31\%$. This result relates determinations quoted in terms of either flow scale and helps assess tensions among published results.
